title: Your mind wanders almost half the time 🧠 #shorts
description:
Your brain doesn't idle in silence. Give it a quiet moment and it fills the gap, often with problems. In a 2010 Harvard study using a phone app, people's minds wandered almost half the time, and they tended to be less happy when they did. 🧠

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/ez-lXPY79pU

#psychology #overthinking #shorts
